name: Druid Elowen

intro.text: Greetings, traveller. I'm on my way to the solstice. It's October. We're early. It's good to be early. It's very fashionable.

win: A fair outcome. The stones will remember this. They remember everything. They never say.
after: I've been a druid for twelve years. The robes are warm, the hours are flexible, and the oak is excellent company.
